name: Guinness Atkinson Global Innovators Fund ETF
name_en: Guinness Atkinson Global Innovators Fund ETF
desc: The fund invests in publicly-traded equity securities of companies that the Advisor believes are positioned for growth due to advances in technology, communications, globalism or innovative management. The adviser will consider all companies in the world's developed stock markets, such as the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Japan, Hong Kong, Singapore, Australia, New Zealand and other stock markets in the European Union. The adviser also may consider investments in emerging stock markets. At least 40% of the fund's assets will be invested in global securities.
